lines: #Ten years from now, you'll be *somewhere.*
The question is *where.*
#Ten years of the same habits takes you to one *place.*
Ten years of small changes takes you somewhere *completely* different.
#Imagine putting away a little every *week.*
Learning one new skill a *year.*
Choosing quality over *impulse.*
Staying patient while everyone else *chases* trends.
#It doesn't look like much in *month* one.
But in year ten? It looks like *freedom.*
#Most people overestimate what they'll do this *year.*
And completely underestimate what they'll do in *ten.*
The seed you plant today is the *shade* you sit in later.
But only if you *plant* it.
#So stop worrying about getting rich by *Christmas.*
Start building something your future self will be *proud* of.
#Write down where you want to be ten years from *today.*
Then ask what small thing you can do this week to get *closer.*
#Ten years will pass either *way.*
Make them *count.*
end: Save this and revisit it in 10 years.
